items.description:
This is a list of privacy-respecting frontends to popular services like social media. All of them are cross-plattform webapps and should work on your device no matter the OS and hardware.
ⓘ You can suggest new frontends and modifications to the list here.
Thanks to 3nprob, aaferrari, heartlog, NxOne14, ZekXtreme, TimDaub, privacytime101, HexagonCDN, Odyssey346, gi-yt, Solomon1732 and lolcatw for their contributions!
Youtube • YT Music • Reddit • Twitter • Imgur • Tiktok • Medium • Quora • GitHub • StackOverflow • IMDb • Genius • XVideos • Fandom • Translate • Search Engines • Instagram • Odysee • Wikipedia • Tools
☰ You can jump between sections via the little menu icon above to the left.
ⓘ Check out the tools section at the bottom to find out how to easily adopt and even self-host.
